title: StatusView
description:
`heimdall status --json` data (a running runtime; with none, the answer is a
`SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` error envelope).

chores.description: ⟨M03⟩ The pending chores. Omitted when none is pending.

open_operations.description: How many open and unresolved operations the caller may see.

operation_counts.description: `inspect operations`' `counts`: every stored operation counted by state.

pending_decisions.description: How many decision records `inspect decisions` lists, expired ones included.

ChoreView.description: ⟨M03⟩ A pending chore the status answer names.

command.description: The command that does it (`heimdall time confirm`).

OperationCountView.description: The number of stored operations in one state.

count.description: How many operations are in it.

OperationState.description: Operation states (spec §11.4). A caller timeout is not a state change.

oneOf.description: Accepted and journaled; not yet running.
Waiting for an owner or provider decision on an owner channel.
Settled: failed with a classified error.

Settled: explicitly cancelled; the result says whether an irreversible or
uncertain step may have occurred.

Unresolved: an external effect may or may not have applied. Quiescent until
reconciliation settles it to `succeeded` or `failed`; never purged while
unresolved; never retried blindly.
